name: Henry E. Gonzales
office: Hacienda La Puente Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Henry E. Gonzales is a retired broker. He served as chair of the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Personnel Commission. He was a booster club president for Wilson High School and Los Altos High School.

sentences.text: Henry E. Gonzales is a retired broker.
He served as chair of the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Personnel Commission.
He was a booster club president for Wilson High School and Los Altos High School.

items.text: In a questionnaire, he identified declining enrollment and long-term financial stability as the district's top needs. He also supports regular compensation studies comparing classified staff pay to other districts. On his campaign site, he calls for prioritizing campus safety, anti-bullying programs, and mental health support.
